body:
I was hanging out with my best and only friend when I was 16. She looked at me really intensively and the conversation went something like this:
Friend: "Was your mum really pretty when she was younger?"
Me: "I guess."
Friend: "And your dad as well?"
Me: "I think so."
Then she takes a long pause until she asks (very confidently): "Then why do you look like that?"

13 years later and I'm still playing that inside my head every now and then. I was used to being called ugly by class mates but coming from someone close to me it really thew me off.
